svg.title: Ginger and cocoa: a little pixel playground
svg.desc: A ginger cat nudges a ball toward a sleepy chocolate-cream cat, who wakes and bats it back. Ginger takes a portal shortcut to catch it. Ginger asks, Play with me? Cocoa agrees, One round. After the portal shortcut, Cocoa asks, Portals? Really? Ginger replies, Work smarter. Cocoa says, Nap harder. Ginger later asks for a rematch. All poses share a consistent head scale and ground line.
